correctness.rationale: The parameter conditions give a smooth hyperelliptic genus-nine curve and explicit fixed-point-free Klein subgroup. All 20 reduced branch points lie in F719; exhaustive 6,840-triple verification gives PGL2 stabilizer order four. Hurwitz 672<719 ensures tame-injective specialization, giving full characteristic-zero Aut order eight at the named rational tuple. Finiteness and semicontinuity of the automorphism functor yield generic order eight and intrinsic free Klein subgroup.

originality.rationale: A complete four-element reduced stabilizer of a 20-point branch set is certified by exhaustive exact arithmetic for one genus-nine specialization and propagated to a nonempty Zariski-open locus by faithful tame specialization and semicontinuity. The checked primary sources describe construction, Prym injectivity, and general dihedral invariants, not this specific full generic group statement. Priority remains provisional because classical classifications may imply the result.
residual_risks: General hyperelliptic automorphism-group classification might imply full-group genericity without the characteristic-719 argument; independent specialist historical review warranted.
The claim does not apply specifically to the smaller 2026 (1,12)-abelian-surface sublocus without a separate dimension/intersection argument.
